description: This file implements the Netlink class for Linux netlink socket communication, including functions for socket management, message sending/receiving, and parsing netlink messages related to network interfaces, addresses, routes, and rules within the quic namespace.

classes.name: LinkInfoParser
classes.description: Parses netlink messages related to network link information, matching interface name and extracting hardware and broadcast addresses.

classes.name: LocalAddressParser
classes.description: Parses netlink messages for local IP addresses associated with a specific network interface.

classes.name: UnknownParser
classes.description: Handles generic netlink messages, primarily for logging purposes.

classes.name: RoutingRuleParser
classes.description: Parses netlink messages related to routing rules, extracting scope, table, destination subnet, and other attributes.

classes.name: IpRuleParser
classes.description: Parses netlink messages for IP rules, extracting source ranges and related info.

methods.name: OpenSocket
methods.description: Opens a netlink socket and binds it to the kernel.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a netlink message to the kernel.

methods.name: Recv
methods.description: Receives netlink messages, handling multi-part replies and parsing messages with a provided parser.

methods.name: GetLinkInfo
methods.description: Retrieves network link information for a specified interface.

methods.name: GetAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves IP addresses associated with a network interface.

methods.name: ChangeLocalAddress
methods.description: Adds or deletes a local IP address on a network interface.

methods.name: GetRouteInfo
methods.description: Retrieves routing rules from the kernel.

methods.name: ChangeRoute
methods.description: Adds, deletes, or replaces a routing rule in the kernel.

methods.name: GetRuleInfo
methods.description: Retrieves IP rules from the kernel.

methods.name: ChangeRule
methods.description: Adds or deletes an IP rule in the kernel.
